title: Threshold Dynamics of Voter Radicalization on the Probability Simplex
summary: We analyse two coupled ODE models of political competition on invariant probability simplices with a conserved electorate. The baseline three-group model tracks left-radical, centrist, and right-radical voter shares. We characterise the unique interior equilibrium by a Perron--Frobenius threshold, establish global asymptotic stability in the symmetric and asymmetric cases, and exclude periodic orbits unconditionally via the Dulac criterion.
